mechanism: Both agents cause CNS depression and additive effects on dopamine/serotonin pathways; prochlorperazine is metabolized via CYP3A4 which buspirone inhibits, potentially increasing prochlorperazine levels.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, dizziness, and extrapyramidal symptoms; consider dose reduction of prochlorperazine if CNS depression occurs; use combination cautiously.
